presentation: All nine measurement RGB frames as ordered images, with frame labels and requested target contours only.
targets: Original QA A/B mapping retained; model receives only visual marks and original question/descriptions.
scoring: Deterministic MCQ matching; invalid/error predictions count as incorrect; denominator 896 per model.
reference_status: Provisional model-estimated geometry labels; no human review.
model_input_policy: Same marked images, question and option order for all models; native per-model visual preprocessing.
scope: Initial evaluation at nine frames; not the papers original benchmark protocol or a 16/32-frame setting.

native_input_packaging.dsr_suite_7b: Same nine marked RGB frames packaged as a video; native final-frame temporal padding and 32 GSM query tokens. fps=2 is an index encoding convention, not measured seconds.

selection_rule: QA audit decision=keep AND group in HLH/LHH/HHH (N=L)
